title: Eval plan
description: One frozen version of how a recipe is scored, at <pattern>.plan.json beside the recipe (autoresearch design, everything-ecosystem docs/design/AUTORESEARCH_RECORDS_2026-11-06.md, "The eval plan"): the as-of points of each window, the horizon and the gap between windows, the read cut, the row weights, the margin a keep needs and the budgets. A person makes it with naive recipes plan (packages/naive/src/engine/recipes/eval-set.ts); its sha is on every experiment line, and its eval set is frozen at <venture>/_eval/<sha>/, a folder no agent reads through the router. The windows run training, a gap, dev, a gap, holdout, and the researcher sees the venture only as of read_cut. That the windows are ordered and purged is checked by the plan command, not by this schema.

version.description: 1 for a recipe's first plan, one more for each plan after it

sha.description: The plan's address: sha256 of the canonical JSON (keys sorted at every level, no whitespace) of every other field, so an experiment line that names it names fixed windows, weights and budgets. Its eval set is _eval/<sha>/

previous.description: The plan this one follows. Its holdout must start after the previous plan's holdout ends, so a holdout point is never reused

made.description: When the plan was made and its eval set frozen

made_by.description: Plans are a person's: an agent never makes or edits one

horizon.description: How long after an as-of point its outcome is settled: a prediction at t is scored against the settled record once t plus the horizon has passed

gap.description: The purge between training and dev, and between dev and holdout, at least the horizon, so no outcome a window is scored on is known inside the window before it

read_cut.description: The researcher reads the venture as of this instant and no later (the reads_as_of clamp, build plan item 7, not built): after the last training outcome settles and before the first dev point

windows.description: The as-of points of each window, in time order. Training gives full feedback, dev one aggregate per experiment, holdout one pass or fail bit per accept

weights.description: How (record, as-of point) rows weigh in the settled loss. cited: a record weighs more when provenance and traces show the venture used it before the cut

min_gain.description: The least loss improvement on dev a keep needs. The margin used is the larger of this and twice the standard error from a block bootstrap seeded by the plan's sha

bootstrap.description: The block bootstrap behind the standard error; the scorer's defaults when left out

block.description: The length of a block of consecutive as-of points resampled together

budgets.description: The fixed budget of the plan version, counted from the experiment log: a failed lint or training run is logged but not counted

dev_evaluations.description: How many experiments may be scored on dev under this plan

holdout_checks.description: How many accepts may check the holdout under this plan; each check answers one bit

limits.description: Compute limits for each sandbox run (packages/naive/src/engine/recipes/sandbox.ts options). Exceeding one fails the experiment; it never changes a score

pattern.description: The projected route pattern the recipe makes, as its file path without .recipe.ts: competitors/[id]/signals, market/rounds
